name: Greenwood Forest
desc: Old woodland roads filled with beasts, goblins and living forest magic.

name: Moonbrook Hollow
desc: Moonlit streams conceal territorial wildlife, poachers and restless nature spirits.

name: Sunfield Plains
desc: Open grasslands patrolled by raiders and fast roaming beasts.

name: Redstone Highlands
desc: Wind-cut highlands where brigands hunt among aggressive mountain wildlife.

name: Ashen Desert
desc: Scorching dunes where fire and poison appear among mostly physical threats.

name: Sunken Shrine
desc: A drowned temple crackling with storm magic and disputed sacred power.

name: Blackwater Swamp
desc: A poisonous marsh of venomous wildlife, ghouls and dark bog magic.

name: Elderwood Ruins
desc: Ancient druidic ruins where fungal growth and awakened trees defend forgotten wards.

name: Ironpeak Mountains
desc: Brutal physical enemies dominate the peaks, with occasional lightning threats.

name: Frozen Tundra
desc: Frozen predators and spirits mix physical attacks with ice and dark magic.

name: Emberfall Volcano
desc: Fire creatures rule the molten caverns, backed by crushing physical brutes.

name: Shattered Coast
desc: Volcanic tides and broken sea-forts shelter corsairs, revenants and glass-scaled beasts.

name: The Voidlands
desc: Reality-warped horrors use dark magic alongside deadly physical attacks.

name: Astral Wilds
desc: A fractured wilderness where creatures phase between starlight and the void.

name: Celestial Battlefield
desc: An abandoned divine battlefield still patrolled by radiant war-machines and fallen heralds.

name: Leviathan Trench
desc: A lightless ocean trench filled with ancient predators and crushing tide magic.

name: Clockwork Wastes
desc: Ruined timeworks produce relentless machines, temporal storms and scavenger artificers.

name: Dreaming Grove
desc: A beautiful forest trapped in a hostile dream where memories take predatory form.

name: Endfall Expanse
desc: The edge of creation collapses into hostile fragments of every known element.

name: Throne of Stars
desc: The final celestial ascent is guarded by immortal wardens and living constellations.
